capabilities: Share the current note as a temporary public URL
Serve the rendered note from a local server via a Cloudflare tunnel
Show a live viewer count for the shared page
Stop sharing to tear down the tunnel and server
disambiguation: Not static-site publishing; the URL exists only while the session is open and serves just the one shared note.
extras: Desktop only (needs a local Node.js server and child process); requires internet to establish the tunnel; the README warns anti-copy mode is a deterrent, not real protection, and that anyone with the URL can read the note. No account, token, or telemetry needed.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to give someone a temporary read-only web link to a single note without storing it on a third-party server.

relations.evidence: Note Wormhole opens its tunnel by running Cloudflare's cloudflared.

summary: Temporary note sharing that serves the current note from a local HTTP server through a Cloudflare quick tunnel, with no cloud upload.
